# Golden Lotus Chinese Restaurant website

Open `index.html` in a browser, or upload this whole folder to any static host.

## Pages
index (home) · menu · takeout-delivery · private-events · about · contact · privacy · accessibility

## Editing
The source lives in the repo folder `golden-lotus/`: `template.html` (header, footer, home), `pages/*.html` (inner pages), `pages.css`, `legal.css`, `seams.css` (generated by `work/gen_deco.py`), `pages.js`. Run `python3 site.py` to rebuild `dist/`.

## Chinese identity (please confirm)
- Chinese name used on the seal and About page: **金荷 (jīn hé)**, "golden lotus". We avoided 金蓮 (jīn lián): in Chinese it is also the old term for bound feet and the name of a notorious novel character.
- If the restaurant already has a Chinese name on its sign, send it and it will replace 金荷 everywhere.
- Characters are Traditional Chinese throughout.

## Online ordering link
Open `site.py`, paste the URL into `ORDER_URL = ''` and rebuild. Every "Order Online" button switches to it.

## Photos
Each photo position has its own file in `img/`. See **PHOTOGRAPHY.md** for the slot map and ChatGPT prompts.

## Facts to confirm (copied from the mockup)
- Address 1236 Wellington Green Dr., Wellington, FL 33414; phone (561) 555-2688 (555 numbers are usually fictional)
- Hours: Mon–Thu 11–9:30, Fri–Sat 11–10, Sun 12–9

- The chef's home region: the menu spans Cantonese, Sichuan and Shanghai dishes. Tell us the kitchen's roots so the About page can say so

## Forms
The contact and event forms check the fields, then say plainly that nothing was sent. Connect a form service (e.g. Formspree) to make them work.

## Design notes
- Seams: (1) hero exit = cream & gilt wave with an ink-wash mountain range; (2) section to section = double gilt rule broken by lotus, coin, cloud and knot motifs; (3) arrival at the red closing band and footer = gilt waves; header and footer dividers use the small motif rule.
- Photo shapes: feature photos use a moon-gate arch or one of two soft squircles (cycled per page); cards use alternating 24/12px corners.
- Each page hero fills the first screen (100svh minus the 65px header).
